title: A fair disciplinary procedure
caption: Each step protects fairness: investigate first, tell the employee what is alleged, hear their response with a companion present, decide in writing and allow an appeal.
alt: Six boxes in order: establish the facts, inform in writing, hold a meeting, the right to be accompanied, decide and inform, the right of appeal.
description: Inform the employee in writing of the issue and evidence.
Hold a meeting so they can respond.
They have the right to be accompanied.
